answer: An attacker running 22 aliases therefore needs 50 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in mesa, expire in beacon, and pulse lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1637 identities would post 4791 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
